_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY. Copy to config/gateway.local.json, then chmod 600. Credentials never go here: the paired-device store lives in state_dir (mode 0700) and is gitignored. broker_timeout_seconds must exceed the broker's limits.runtime_max_sec by >=60s, otherwise the gateway can time out first and a late ack/reply desyncs the next exchange (broker_runtime_max_seconds is used only to enforce that margin).
